Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje pentru automatizări
Hello World, We are hiring!
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future.
Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant team.
Siemens Software, a business unit of the Siemens Digital Industries, is a leading global provider of software solutions to drive the digital transformation of industry, creating new opportunities for manufacturers to realize innovation.
 About this Role:
 The Simulation Business Segment (SIM) is part of Siemens Digital Industries Software and delivers industry‑leading simulation and test solutions that power digital twin technologies . Our portfolio spans mechanical, thermal, fluid, electromagnetic, system, and AI‑driven engineering , enabling customers to design, validate, and optimize products with confidence.
With a global team of approximately 3,500 professionals , SIM is driven by a shared commitment to responsibility, excellence, and innovation .
As a Quality Management Specialist , you will become part of the SIM Quality Management & Information Security Management team, a small group of passionate professionals who thrive on mutual respect , collaboration , and a positive mindset . Together we are driven by a shared mission:
 “Empowering every SIM employee to deliver secure and world‑class quality products and services.”
 In this role, you will work closely with stakeholders across the Simulation Business Segment. You will have a visible impact on quality and information security culture, compliance, and continuous improvement across a complex and innovative software organization.
 What you’ll be doing:
 Quality Management & Information Security Management (QM&ISM) for Assigned Sub‑Units
Act as the QM&ISM focal point for specific sub‑units within the Simulation Business Segment
Organize and facilitate QM&ISM Interlock meetings to address quality topics and risks
Collaborate with auditors to plan, prepare, conduct, and debrief internal audits
Define, coordinate, and track improvement actions in close cooperation with action owners
Plan and lead annual Management Review meetings for assigned sub‑units
Review and analyze quality KPIs and metrics
Analyze the results of the annual Voice of the Customer surveys
Provide regular QM&ISM status reporting to your line manager
 Segment‑Wide Quality Initiatives
Take a leading role in SIM‑wide QM&ISM projects/activities, such as workflow automation, global audit planning, or record management
Provide expert support and guidance across multiple QM&ISM disciplines
Proactively identify issues and formulate improvement proposals for management
Contribute to the definition of QM&ISM policies, direction, and best practices
Mentor and train colleagues on QM&ISM topics
Explore and evaluate state‑of‑the‑art technologies, tools, and methodologies to continuously improve quality and information security processes
 What You'll Bring:
 Required
Solid foundation in Quality Management / Information Security Management principles
Knowledge of the ISO 9001 Quality Management Standard
Knowledge of the ISO 27001 Information Security Standard
Practical experience with the application of Artificial Intelligence
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel
Ability to deliver high‑quality, well‑structured outputs
Strong attention to detail
A collaborative team‑player mindset
 Nice to Have
Knowledge of Nuclear Quality Assurance (e.g. NQA‑1)
 Working at Siemens Software
 A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
Siemens is not the same manufacturing company as in the past. We are helping our customers get to tomorrow faster through innovation and digitalization and are transforming alongside them. We are a modern, forward-looking software company, with the opportunities of a large corporation, where your opportunities are endless. The role you apply for today is only the first step in your Siemens journey.
 Compensation & Benefits
 The primary location for this opportunity is Romania, UK, France and Greece. The applicable salary range for these locations is:
EUR 45,800 – EUR 78,000 (France)
GPB 44,200- GPB 68,800 (UK)
RON 145,300- RON 276,000 (Romania)
EUR 26,300 – EUR 52,600 (Greece)
This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/
This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.
 Diversity & Inclusion
 We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from all candidates. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. Please contact us to request accommodation.
